construct_or_mutation: IRD12 (U-13C/15N), recombinant Pin-II type inhibitory repeat domain from Capsicum annuum; first Gly is part of TEV cleavage site
other_conditions: 0.6 mM IRD12 with 10% 2H2O; 800 MHz Bruker with cryogenic probe; related structures: none
residues_author: D30, D42; first three N-terminal residues; region 30-45 differs from IRD7
author_claim: Heteronuclear NOE shows most IRD12 residues are rigid; flexibility is limited to the first three N-terminal residues and D30 and D42, and the 30-45 region differs from IRD7. Only NOE values are given (Fig. 3); no rates or models.
anchor: excluding first three residues at the N-terminal for both IRD7 and IRD12 and two other residues (D30 and D42) in the case of IRD12, almost all residues show substantial amount of rigidity
locator: Assignments and data deposition, text on Fig. 3; conditions: Methods NMR spectroscopy and Fig. 3 legend
